name: Jefferson County, WA
findings: Jefferson County has 178 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Jefferson County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
